packs.name: Download Update
packs.description:
Update Available

Patch Notes are available in the Official Minecraft Steam Edition Discord Server

Fresh Installation instuctions:

Step 1: Download Update and open your game instances main folder

Step 2: Open the STEAM UPDATES folder, cut and paste the Minecraft Steam Edition SU38.mrpack in to any folder of your choosing, and then install it to whatever launcher you're currently using.

Then you are finished updating!

Game Version: SU38
